content: hmmlearn maintenance is inactive as of Dec 2025 - latest release 0.3.3 (Oct 31 2024), no releases in past 12+ months, considered low-maintenance/limited-maintenance mode by health trackers (Snyk). Still functional and API-stable (scikit-learn-like), but project's existing fallback-to-volatility-percentile pattern is a prudent hedge against this. Alternatives: pomegranate (more flexible/faster, active), but switching cost not justified given hmmlearn already integrated and working.
